name: Volumetric Ray Marching with Glass Refraction and Denoising Guides
definition: A recursive ray marching loop for volumetric rendering that handles opaque surfaces, diffuse irradiance caching, GGX specular microfacet reflection, and glass refraction, including a specific guide generation step for denoising refracted pixels.
summary: A recursive ray marching loop for volumetric rendering that decouples denoising guide computation from radiance accumulation by tracing refracted rays through glass to provide accurate albedo and normal data.
